description:
Past signals, for checking whether a kind of signal has worked historically
    before acting on a live one.

    blockchain: solana, bnb, base, eth or rh
    wallet_type: kol, smart or whale (default kol)
    days: 7, 30, 90 or "all" (default 30)
    mode: cluster, entry or exit. Omit for all modes.
    limit: how many signals (default 25)

blockchain.description: Blockchain. One of: solana, bnb, base, eth, rh. solana has kol, smart and whale wallets; bnb, base and rh have kol and smart; eth has kol only. rh is Robinhood Chain, an Ethereum L2.
blockchain.title: Blockchain

days.description: How far back to look: 7, 30, 90 or all.
days.title: Days

limit.description: How many entries to return. Keep it small: large results are trimmed to fit the context window anyway.
limit.title: Limit

mode.description: Restrict to cluster, entry or exit. Leave empty for every mode.
mode.title: Mode

wallet_type.description: Wallet type. kol is a Key Opinion Leader, an influencer whose calls move markets. smart is a wallet selected for its track record. whale is a large holder, Solana only.
wallet_type.title: Wallet Type

name: get_signal_history
